title: Correct Calculation of Units to Buy/Sell
preconditions: User has input target and current percentages for each security.
steps: 1. Calculate the units to buy/sell for each security based on the target and current percentages. 2. Validate the calculations.
expected_result: The units to buy/sell are calculated correctly for each security.

title: Validate Target Share Percentages Post-Rebalance
preconditions: Account ABC has been rebalanced according to the target percentages.
steps: 1. Retrieve the current share percentages for each security after rebalancing. 2. Compare the current share percentages with the target percentages.
expected_result: The target share percentages match the actual percentages for IBM, MSFT, ORCL, AAPL, and HD.

title: Validate Deviation Percentage Post-Rebalance
preconditions: Account ABC has been rebalanced according to the target percentages.
steps: 1. Retrieve the deviation percentages for each security after rebalancing. 2. Check that all deviation percentages are 0.
expected_result: The deviation percentage is 0 for all securities after rebalancing.

title: Validate Total Number of Shares Post-Rebalance
preconditions: Account ABC has been rebalanced according to the target percentages.
steps: 1. Calculate the total number of shares post-rebalancing. 2. Compare it with the sum of original shares and units to buy/sell.
expected_result: The total number of shares post-rebalancing matches the sum of original shares and units to buy/sell.

title: Validate Company Names After Allocation
preconditions: User is preparing to allocate investments.
steps: 1. Input a list of company names for allocation. 2. Validate the company names against a list of valid securities.
expected_result: All company names are valid after allocation.

title: Validate Securities which are not traded have same share percentage before and after rebalance
steps: 1. Check the total share percentage after rebalancing for the shares which are not passed for rebalanced.
expected_result: The total share percentages for each of those securities remain unchanged .

title: Validate Total Asset Valuation Post-Rebalance
steps: 1. Calculate the total asset valuation before and after rebalancing. 2. Compare the two values.
expected_result: The total asset valuation remains unchanged after rebalancing.

title: Validate bad rebalance request when security name is wrong
preconditions: Attempt to rebablance with security name which is not in valid security names

title: System Failure During Rebalancing
steps: 1. Simulate a system failure during the rebalance process. 2. Attempt to recover the system.
expected_result: The system recovers gracefully without data loss and allows the user to retry the rebalance.

title: Empty Input for Rebalance
preconditions: User attempts to rebalance with no input data.
steps: 1. Submit a rebalance request with empty input fields.
expected_result: The system returns an error indicating that input data is required.

title: Unauthorized Access to Rebalance Functionality
preconditions: User is not authorized to perform rebalancing.
steps: 1. Attempt to access the rebalance functionality without proper permissions.
expected_result: The system denies access and returns an unauthorized error message.

title: Floating-Point Precision in Calculations
preconditions: User inputs target percentages that require precise calculations.
steps: 1. Input target percentages that result in floating-point calculations. 2. Validate the results.
expected_result: The calculations maintain precision and do not result in rounding errors.

title: Boundary Value for 0% Target Allocation
preconditions: User sets a target allocation of 0% for a security.
steps: 1. Set the target allocation for one security to 0%. 2. Attempt to rebalance.
expected_result: The system processes the rebalance correctly without errors.

title: Boundary Value for 100% Target Allocation
preconditions: User sets a target allocation of 100% for a security.
steps: 1. Set the target allocation for one security to 100%. 2. Attempt to rebalance.
expected_result: The system processes the rebalance correctly without errors.
